meta.name: aerodrome_village
meta.prompt: An interwar aerodrome village on a grassy plain: a great silver airship moored to its mooring mast above the hangars, biplanes lined up on the field, a small terminal building and a row of crew cottages along the lane.

tokens.terrain: a flat, open grassy plain with an expansive grass landing field
tokens.icons: a giant silver rigid airship moored to a tall steel mooring mast; corrugated iron hangars beside the airfield; a row of biplanes parked along the flight line; a small art deco terminal building with an observation roof; a row of neat crew cottages along a tree-lined lane
tokens.infra: airfield perimeter lane connecting the crew cottages to the terminal, hangars, and mooring field
